title: The input of the production qualification of P/01
description: Machine form of N6.2 of spec/acceptance.norms.md. format and source_pin are required; an absent budgets key, manager or volume is not a data error: dependent entries are not_executed with its name as the reason (N6.5). The shape of threshold_ref does not establish approval; resolve the published Q approval record and confirm its accessible ADR or budget text for the same value, unit, observed result and scope. A nonempty diagnostic or unresolved reference is valid in this form but leaves the dependent threshold unapproved. Integer fields are JSON integer tokens.

threshold_ref.description: Exact reference to a sealed Q threshold approval record in Platform/01-store/forms/production/threshold-approvals.json#/records/<id>. A nonempty string passes this schema only; a diagnostic, unresolved or unconfirmed reference yields not_executed with the budget key as reason. The qualifier must resolve the record and compare budget_key, value, unit, observed_result and scope against accessible ADR or budget approval text before measurement.
threshold_ref.$comment: Do not replace resolution with minLength or a syntactic match. Unapproved references remain input data, not approval and not a schema error solely because they cannot be resolved.
